title: Super Robot Taisen F (Demo)
native_title: スーパー・ロボット大戦Ｆ
overview:
Justice is in our hands! Super robots, a battle of souls!!

Super Robot Taisen F is a simulation RPG that gathers giant robots and pilots from many anime series, including Getter Robo and Neon Genesis Evangelion, into one army fighting to defend the Earth.

On the map, move your units turn by turn, watch each machine's HP and energy, and pick the right attack for every matchup. Each clash plays out as an animated battle scene with the pilots calling out their moves. Between fights, the story unfolds in conversations, and pilots gain levels and use spirit commands to turn the tide.

This disc is a demo version of the game.

- 1 player
- Robots and pilots from a range of anime series
- Animated battle scenes for every attack

正義は我が手に！スーパーロボット、魂の戦い！！
